headline: Omen AI Acquires Aquatic Labs to Enhance Data Center Cooling Tech
summary: Omen AI has acquired Aquatic Labs to integrate ocean-sensing expertise into automating data center cooling systems.
why: Artificial intelligence infrastructure expansion relies heavily on advanced data center cooling solutions to maintain efficient operations.

impacts.name: Omen AI
impacts.why: The acquisition expands Omen AI's technological capabilities in data center cooling systems.
